launches.title: Regbase: Al-native Legal Research
launches.tagline: Hundreds of hours of legal research in one click!
launches.body:
**Regbase helps companies track new laws across the world and at the local level.**

Regbase is an **AI-native research platform** built to help **legal teams, researchers, and government vendors** monitor regulatory changes across countries, languages, and **hard-to-find government sources**.

[https://youtu.be/lY1La0A4iaw](https://youtu.be/lY1La0A4iaw?si=-dCa9ucc4Sq8jvXR)

**The problem:** 

Companies that need to track new laws still rely heavily on **manual research.** Many important updates are posted on obscure local websites, draft bill portals, consultation pages, social media, and other sources that may **never get indexed by Google or picked up by LLMs.** 

If a law is not in English, not covered by the media, or it only applies at the local level, it can be **impossible to find.** 

\
**The solution:** 

Regbase finds these updates automatically, including draft bills, consultations, compliance requirements, and sales opportunities like grants. Then it analyzes them. 

So far we have: 

* **Found $400M in expiring school safety grants** across the U.S. for a client selling protective equipment
* Identified **80** **requirements** for greenhouse gas disclosure **in 45 countries** for a global manufacturer
* Found **dozens of obscure laws in non-English languages, posted only on LinkedIn, Facebook or X**
* Uncovered regulations hidden behind QR codes, and even one government website that required visitors to watch an ad! 

**Who we are:** 

**Natalie Aresta-Katz**, previously led a law firm practice research team at Paul, Weiss, tracking laws across dozens of countries and every state. **Ethan Shea** is a former Staff Engineer at Vercel with expertise building agentic infrastructure. They started the company after years of struggling with manual regulatory updates across jurisdictions and languages.

**The ask:** 

We are eager to help **lawyers and researchers** in all areas, including **employment, AI, climate/sustainability, and private equity.** We also work with **companies in regulated industries,** and state and **local government vendors.**

Visit [regbase.com](http://regbase.com) or email us at [founders@regbase.com](mailto:founders@regbase.com) to book a time.

Follow us:  [https://www.linkedin.com/company/regbase](https://www.linkedin.com/company/regbase/) | <https://x.com/theregbase>
